items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: We went into the Paramount Theater, my first time in the Paramount Theater, with Dorothy Lamour and Mischa Auer, and that was our first of quite a few Paramount engagements.

ctx.x: It doesn't say here. Which Bakaleinikoff, Mischa or Constantine?
So you were inducted seven times, but were you actually in the service?
